GS.rationale: Goldman Sachs is a high-quality franchise with genuine fundamental improvement — ROE up from 10.0% to 13.4% (quant) and reaching 19.8% in Q1 2026 (qual), net margin expanded 450bp to 28.4%, and the firm delivered FY2025 EPS of $51.32 (+27% YoY) with Q1 2026 EPS of $17.55 beating consensus by 7.4%. The #1 global M&A advisory position (32% market share, $1.48T in deals) and strategic pivot away from failed consumer banking ($7B+ losses) toward durable fee-based revenues (AWM management fees >$10B, AUM $3.6T) represent a credible structural improvement. However, the stock has already re-rated aggressively: PE at 17.5x is at the 85th percentile of its 12-18.4x range, P/B at 2.34x is near its 2.5x ceiling, and the stock sits at the 94th percentile of its 52-week range at $923.77. The equity risk premium over 10Y Treasuries is compressed to ~130bp. FICC intermediation revenue declined 10% YoY in Q1 2026, and GBM's 71% revenue share leaves the firm exposed to cyclical downturns. The market has largely priced in the margin and ROE recovery, leaving limited upside from current levels absent further fundamental acceleration. A mild positive score reflects the franchise quality and upward consensus revisions (+3.5% for FY2026 EPS over 30 days) while acknowledging the valuation has front-run much of the improvement.
